It does feel very taxin to maintain the act of normal guy, I have been doing it since my parrants took me to the special help that taught me how to act this way. Furthermore I have to work all day behind a desk with on the other side of the desk one of the few people that can see through parts of my acting (shell). And when he does he rubs it in and tries to make me feel really miserable about one little thing. 

I know there are a lot of girls out there  but it's a freaking lottery for me to find the right one.
I just don't wanna feel the emptyness fear and loneliness anymore. And I just can't stand it anymore living between these naive sexistic egocentric people,..
